hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Significant cracking and degradation of the roadway and sidewalk surfaces present tripping and vehicle control hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground roadway and sidewalk areas

hazards.name: Lack of mid-block crossing
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible for a significant stretch of the block, potentially leading to unsafe jaywalking.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic, increasing the risk of collisions during mid-block crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line on both sides of the street

hazards.name: Wide multi-lane roadway
hazards.description: The four-lane configuration encourages higher vehicle speeds and creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: No sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: The lack of a planting strip or physical barrier between the sidewalk and the travel lanes increases the risk to pedestrians from errant vehicles.

hazards.name: Undefined Vehicle Access
hazards.description: A wide, unmarked area allows vehicles to cross the sidewalk to park or load, creating unpredictable conflict points.
hazards.location_in_image: Area in front of the deli on the right.

hazards.name: Poor Roadway Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and degraded asphalt can lead to tripping or vehicle instability.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt can create uneven surfaces for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Roadway Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and patching in the asphalt surface could pose a trip hazard or affect vehicle handling.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street block sight lines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Wide curb cut and parking lot entrance
hazards.description: A large, undefined driveway area creates a wide conflict zone where pedestrians are exposed to turning vehicles without physical protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left, where the sidewalk is interrupted by the parking lot entrance

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb and within the lot obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming traffic, especially near the informal crossing point.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground right and left curb lines

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: Pedestrians are observed crossing midblock without any markings, signage, or traffic control to alert drivers to their presence.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway where a pedestrian is currently crossing

hazards.name: Lack of physical separation
hazards.description: Sidewalks are directly adjacent to the roadway with only a curb and parked cars for separation, providing minimal protection from traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the street

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line where cars are parked

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, reducing exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crossings with high-visibility paint and signage to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the wide sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters in a furniture zone to provide vertical separation and a psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Waste Management Infrastructure
interventions.description: Install permanent, secured trash receptacles to prevent the accumulation of loose debris on the walkway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the concrete walkway to eliminate tripping hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lamps designed to illuminate the walkway rather than just the roadway to improve safety and security.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth surface for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Enhancements
interventions.description: If this is a frequent bus stop or crossing point, install high-visibility crosswalks and curb extensions to improve sightlines around large vehicles.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway and repair the sidewalk to eliminate tripping hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Utility Undergrounding or Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to the edge of the sidewalk or underground them to clear the pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide a physical and psychological buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to provide a designated safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Tables
interventions.description: Introduce vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use area.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reducing the number of travel lanes can lower vehicle speeds and provide space for pedestrian safety enhancements like a median or bike lanes.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and Bollards
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions or bollards to clearly define the pedestrian realm and prevent vehicle encroachment.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and increase the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Buffer
interventions.description: Add a line of street trees or planters between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: High-visibility midblock crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a continental-style marked crosswalk with pedestrian crossing signage to formalize the crossing point.

interventions.title: Driveway narrowing and continuous sidewalk
interventions.description: Reconstruct the parking lot entrance to be narrower with a continuous sidewalk level and material to prioritize pedestrian movement and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-Block Crossing
interventions.description: Add a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and pedestrian warning signage.

interventions.title: Waste Management
interventions.description: Provide public trash receptacles to reduce litter and maintain a clear walking path.
